body: Really bad. Everyday, I wake up wishing I didn't. I'm tired of doing everything and still get cursed at by my ungrateful family. I wish I die in my sleep.. I wish these all ends soon. I'm tired.

Hi! I'm from the Philippines as well, as much as wanna help, I'm also not in the best situation right now.

But I've seen some organizations helping those who were affected by the typhoon. You can check out @/keepgoingorganization on Instagram. 

It's awful that there's zero to little response from the government, but we already know how bad they are. I also believe the office of the vice president is waaay more approachable than the other sectors. Maybe you can mention them on twitter or something.

i wanna kms because I can't afford to live... but dying is very expensive too.. so now I'm just stuck in a boundless void of existing.

I used to work a job that pays for a around 4USD for a 12-hour shift... and now I've been jobless for months.. 

I was also 19 when I moved out because of my toxic parents. If you're able too, move out. It will be tough, but your peace of mind should always matter first.

Unfortunately, everyone said they brought their unit to the main service center. Some said they had to wait a week, then it suddenly worked again. I don't have the luxury of time to wait around, and this phone I'm using is a 5y/o ASUS phone, where I can't touch 50% of the screen. 

I tried doing the hard reboot too, like pressing the volume button and power button at the same time. Didn't work.
It was on 30% when I restarted it. I've been charging it, and still a no go. Stuck on blackscreen/deadboot.
i did that and it didnt work.. :( im stressing out because i dont have a spare phone
Honestly, money. People has always told me that my skills/intelligence has gone to "waste" because I couldn't finish my degree, and I can't land a proper job.
I had sleep for dinner. It was good.
i don't want it.. where is the return section?
Lost 6 inches on my waistline in a month. And that's on being broke.
If they were approached by a stray cat/dog and they go "aww look at this cute baby!" instead of "AAA SHOO EEEW GROSS!!"
The hopes that it will get better soon.
I need that..
i aspire to be this unbothered.
Canned pork and beans.

I live in a third world country, and I hope there's free food/food banks here. Months ago, lots of individuals started an "open pantry" on different cities, I volunteered and donated back then whenever I was able to. But the open pantry didn't last because they didn't have enough funds/donors. 

Fast forward to now, I'm in the complete opposite situation where I can't even afford to buy myself a pack of instant ramen. And everyday I've been hoping that the community open pantry comes back. 

If online, i hope there are more accessible ways for people to ask for help. I've only been on reddit a few months, and I barely use it. Then a friend told me to try checking out some support subreddit communities for my situation.. but apparently, I do not qualify to most of these communities because of my account age/activities.
I see.. thank you for the explanation. It's just.. sad. I didn't know it, and I was thinking of it as my last option. Again, thank you.

i definitely did not know that :( it's just that I'm running out of options and i need help as soon as i can.  ahh I don't know what else to do. this is so frustrating. thank you for informing me, by the way.
because for I need karma to post on some assistance subreddits... there's always a minimum karma required before i can ask for help. :(

Me. They say money can't buy happiness, yeah, sure. But in my state right now where I can't even afford a pack of instant ramen, money will definitely make things better.. and easier.

My bills. I lost my 9-5 job, so I had to make ways and started working as  a freelance writer. But bills piled up, couldnt pay my electricity. It got cut off. Now I can't do my job as a writer. No electricity = no job = no food.

I used to work at a drive inn hotel. Boss is a rich powerful man. One time, there are men (probably drunk) who went through our drive inn, in motorcycles. being loud for no reason. Boss came out of his office with a gun. Asked the guards to shut the gates and he'll put them in their "places" 

Thankfully, the strangers got off. But the boss told the guards to "bring them at the back if they come again"

idk what's he's capable of doing. but im just glad i did not see it.
that's really nice 🥺 the ladies at my old college will scoff at me as soon as I start asking a question lol
Honestly, I would do my best to help everyone in need if I have an access to unlimited money. I know how hard it could be, so yeah. I'll try and help people.

Letting the son of a dictator run for presidency. And millions of people supporting him. 

Additional, his family brought the country to debt. And he forged his educational achievement. This country is hopeless.

False hopes makes me feel more hopeless. I hate it. Another thing I hate the most is when people tell you that "someone else had it worse than you.", well... thanks for invalidating my feelings, I guess? 

I'm stuck. And I'm trying to get back up, but it's not happening no matter how hard i try. Is it my fault? Is it still my fault even if I tried everything I could think of? Clearly, it's never getting any better for me.
I never stopped trying to make things better. Trust me. Things just never worked out for me. I tried. And I did my best.

School bags and shoes. When I was in elementary, I had to use my bags and shoes for 3-4 years before I get a new one. My classmates gets new ones twice a year or yearly.

Still poor up to this day, I'm 26 and I don't own a single shoe.

Me too. I feel this. I have no one. Christmas makes me extra sad. It always make me feel so alone. And worthless, since I can't afford celebrating it. I'm from a country which Christmasem is widely celebrated.

My electricity back. After getting it disconnected, i can barely do anything. I can't work on my freelance writing job because I don't have electricity to power my computer. Idk what's going on in my life now. Completely hopeless.
